runtime_obligations: on_start successful definite initialization before receive
on_start failure prohibits mailbox dispatch and reports supervisor notice
serial drain of two admitted messages 1 then 2 observes count snapshots 1 then 3
shared-message interleaving read is a snapshot, not transactional own-update result
independent Counter instances never alias state
reader/writer exclusion and fair nonparking admission
critical scopes cleaned on exception cancellation panic STOP
post-STOP stale generation lease cannot access reincarnated actor
cross-TenantVM handles cannot read/write state and cannot transfer state views
evidence_rule: Passing requires exact compiler and target SHA, nonempty executed build+test steps, successful positive guest runs, rejection without guest artifact for negatives, runtime isolation and lifecycle traces; source fixture checks alone never count.
